_comment: Example settings. CtrlNote creates config.json itself on first run; this file only documents the keys. Unknown keys are ignored.

_fields.vault_path: Path to your Obsidian vault folder
_fields.hotkey: Global hotkey for a quick note (e.g. ctrl+alt+n)
_fields.last_folder: Last folder used inside the vault (empty = vault root)
_fields.auto_folder: Pick a folder from the active window title
_fields.whisper_model: Local model size: tiny | base | small | medium
_fields.voice_engine: local = on this PC, openai = cloud
_fields.openai_api_key: OpenAI key (encrypted with Windows DPAPI in the real config.json)
_fields.link_daily_note: Append [[today]] to the end of each note
_fields.append_daily_note: Write a link into the daily note file
_fields.trade_hotkey: Trader edition: hotkey for the trade window
_fields.trade_vault_path: Trader edition: vault for trades (empty = same as notes)
_fields.trade_folder: Trader edition: trades folder (empty = Trades / Сделки by language)
_fields.trade_attachments_folder: Trader edition: screenshots folder (empty = Screenshots / Фотки by language)
_fields.trade_sol_usd: Trader edition: last known SOL price (used when offline)
